title: Electrum wallet data
whyItMatters: Electrum keeps wallet files holding keys and transaction history. Losing them can make the coins unrecoverable without the seed phrase.
source: Electrum documentation, FAQ "Where is my wallet file located?": the data directory on macOS is ~/.electrum (wallets in ~/.electrum/wallets)
notes: Earlier draft used ~/Library/Application Support/Electrum, which is not where Electrum keeps wallets. Reviewed in W3-D2 (independent review, docs/research/macos-review.md).
